title: 聊兴趣与热情

sentenceFrames.usage: 表达热忱。"really into" 比 "like" 强烈，"like" 后面的补充让表达更自然。
sentenceFrames.example: I'm really into photography — like, I'll spend hours editing a single photo and not even notice the time pass.

sentenceFrames.usage: 说出你怎么开始一个兴趣的——每件事都有个起点，这就是故事。
sentenceFrames.example: I got into running because I missed my bus one day and had to run 3 kilometers to work. Turns out, I actually enjoyed it.
substitutions: I got into **my current hobby** because _____.
I got into **the work I do** because _____.

sentenceFrames.usage: 不只是说"我喜欢"，而是说出"为什么喜欢"——这才是吸引人的部分。
sentenceFrames.example: What I find fascinating about learning languages is how it changes the way you think — you literally start seeing the world differently.
substitutions: What I find **interesting** about **social media** is _____.
What I find **frustrating** about **my phone** is _____.
What I find **rewarding** about **my hobby** is _____.
What I find **fascinating** about **human behavior** is _____.

collocations.english: be hooked on / be addicted to
a way to unwind / blow off steam
try new things / step out of my comfort zone
give up halfway / not follow through
